title: Coin Heaven region
description: Everything Coin Heaven assumes about one country. Percentages are written as percentages (19 means 19%) and money in whole units of the currency (6000 means six thousand).

id.description: The file's name without .json — the country code, in lower case: us, mx, de.

name.description: What the country is called in its own language. Shown in Settings.

country.description: The country in English. Told to the AI assistant so it knows whose shops and rules to think of.

locale.description: A language tag such as en-US or de-DE. Decides digit grouping, the decimal mark and how dates are written.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code: EUR, GBP, MXN.

currencySymbol.description: The symbol shown next to amounts.

investmentTax.description: Tax on gains when investments are sold. Used by the FIRE page to work out how much more has to be withdrawn to cover it.

name.description: What the tax is called locally.

year.description: The tax year these rates are for.

source.description: Where the rates were read: the tax authority's site.

bands.description: From the lowest band up. A flat-rate country has one band. A tax-free allowance is a first band with rate 0.

upTo.description: Gains a year up to which this rate applies. Leave it out on the last band.

note.description: A caution shown beside the rates: what they leave out, and who they are for.

withdrawalRate.description: Share of the portfolio taken out each year, in percent. Default 4.

property.description: What a new buy-to-let plan in the Simulator starts from. Leave out whatever you do not know.

purchaseTax.description: Tax on buying a second-hand home, percent of the price.

mortgageShare.description: Share of the price a bank typically lends, percent.

mortgageRate.description: Typical mortgage interest rate, percent a year.

otherPurchaseCosts.description: Notary, registry and fees, percent of the price.

maxDebtToIncome.description: Share of income banks allow all debt payments to reach, percent.

rentCountedByBank.description: Share of rent a bank counts as income, percent.

fixedCostsPerYear.description: Yearly cost of owning one property: local taxes, insurance, community fees.

agencyFee.description: Letting agent's fee, percent of rent.

maintenance.description: Set aside for repairs, percent of rent.

merchantNoise.description: Words that appear on bank statement lines and identify no shop — "purchase", "pos debit", "compra". Coin Heaven ignores them when it works out which merchant a line is from, so two visits to the same shop look alike.
